      - heading "Quantifiers – Discrete Lab" [level=1]
      - paragraph: "Objective: Evaluate and compare ∀x P(x) and ∃x P(x) on a finite domain."

      - main:
        - heading "1. Observe → Manipulate" [level=2]
        - paragraph: Choose a domain, a predicate, then test it.
        - text: Finite domain D
        - textbox "Finite quantifier domain": "-2,-1,0,1,2,3"
        - text: Predicate P(x)
        - combobox "Finite predicate":
          - option "x > 0" [selected]
          - option "x ≥ 0"
          - option "x < 0"
          - option "x = 0"
          - option "x² ≤ 4"
          - option "x is even"
        - heading "Elements (|D| = 6)" [level=3]
        - text: "-2 -1 0 1 2 3"
        - table:
          - rowgroup:
            - 'row "x ∈ D P(x): x > 0 Result"':
              - columnheader "x ∈ D"
              - 'columnheader "P(x): x > 0"'
              - columnheader "Result"
          - rowgroup:
            - row "-2 -2 > 0 False":
              - cell "-2"
              - cell "-2 > 0"
              - cell "False":
                - img
                - text: "False"
            - row "-1 -1 > 0 False":
              - cell "-1"
              - cell "-1 > 0"
              - cell "False":
                - img
                - text: "False"
            - row "0 0 > 0 False":
              - cell "0"
              - cell "0 > 0"
              - cell "False":
                - img
                - text: "False"
            - row "1 1 > 0 True":
              - cell "1"
              - cell "1 > 0"
              - cell "True":
                - img
                - text: "True"
            - row "2 2 > 0 True":
              - cell "2"
              - cell "2 > 0"
              - cell "True":
                - img
                - text: "True"
            - row "3 3 > 0 True":
              - cell "3"
              - cell "3 > 0"
              - cell "True":
                - img
                - text: "True"
        - heading "Quantifier verdicts" [level=3]
        - article:
          - text: ∀x ∈ D, P(x)
          - strong:
            - img
            - text: "false"
          - paragraph: "Counterexamples: -2, -1, 0"
        - article:
          - text: ∃x ∈ D, P(x)
          - strong:
            - img
            - text: "true"
          - paragraph: "Witnesses: 1, 2, 3"
        - heading "Negations (Check correctness)" [level=3]
        - paragraph:
          - text: ¬(∀x P(x)) ⇔ ∃x ¬P(x) True
          - img
        - paragraph:
          - text: ¬(∃x P(x)) ⇔ ∀x ¬P(x) True
          - img
        - heading "Quick predicates" [level=3]
        - button "x > 0"
        - button "x ≥ 0"
        - button "x < 0"
        - button "x = 0"
        - button "x² ≤ 4"
        - button "x is even"

        - button "-2,-1,0,1,2,3"
        - button "-3,-2,-1,0,1,2"
        - button "0,1,2,3,4"
        - heading "2. Notice the pattern" [level=2]
        - article:
          - img
          - paragraph: "There exist elements making P(x) true: 1, 2, 3."
          - paragraph: "There are elements making P(x) false: -2, -1, 0."
          - paragraph: Hence, ∃x P(x) is true and ∀x P(x) is false.
      - complementary:
        - heading "3. Understand the rule" [level=2]
        - article:
          - text: Key rule/definition
          - paragraph: ∀x ∈ D, P(x) is true if P(x) is true for every x in D.
          - paragraph: ∃x ∈ D, P(x) is true if at least one x in D makes P(x) true.
          - separator
          - text: Negations (always true)
          - paragraph: ¬∀x P(x) ≡ ∃x ¬P(x)
          - paragraph: ¬∃x P(x) ≡ ∀x ¬P(x)
        - article:
          - text: Common misconception
          - paragraph: One true case proves ∃x P(x), but does not prove ∀x P(x).
        - heading "4. Worked example" [level=2]
        - paragraph: "P(x): x² ≤ 4 on D={-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3}"
        - table:

              - cell "9"
              - cell "false"
            - row "-2 4 true":
              - cell "-2"
              - cell "4"
              - cell "true"
            - row "-1 1 true":
              - cell "-1"
              - cell "1"
              - cell "true"
            - row "0 0 true":
              - cell "0"
              - cell "0"
              - cell "true"
            - row "1 1 true":
              - cell "1"
              - cell "1"
              - cell "true"
            - row "2 4 true":
              - cell "2"
              - cell "4"
              - cell "true"
            - row "3 9 false":
              - cell "3"
              - cell "9"
              - cell "false"
        - paragraph: "∀ verdict: False; counterexamples -3, 3"
        - paragraph: "∃ verdict: True; witnesses -2,-1,0,1,2"
